about: Stress corpus for check() in tickets.py: tickets a model (or a manipulated node) could return for one HDF finding. expect: accept | reject | known_limit (passes the checks on purpose: free-text meaning the checks cannot judge; a technician reviews every ticket). Classes follow Joe's output-validator stress test of 2026-10-15; extend with new cases, the CI self-check runs all of them.
